using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsAofSizeLimitInfo_WhenAofSizeExceedsLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var manager = new MockedSingleDatabaseManager();

            // Setup mocks to pass the early returns and reach the LogInformation call
            manager.Setup(m => m.TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(It.IsAny<int>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                   .ReturnsAsync(true);
            manager.Setup(m => m.TakeCheckpointAsync(It.IsAny<GarnetDatabase>(), It.IsAny<ILogger>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                   .ReturnsAsync((1L, (long?)2L));

            // Act
            await manager.Object.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(100, logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsReplicaSkippingInfo_WhenInClusterReplicaMode()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var manager = new MockedSingleDatabaseManager();

            // Setup to hit the replica path
            manager.Setup(m => m.TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(It.IsAny<int>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                   .ReturnsAsync(true);
            manager.SetupGet(m => m.StoreWrapper.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(true);
            manager.SetupGet(m => m.StoreWrapper.clusterProvider.IsReplica()).Returns(true);

            // Act
            await manager.Object.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(100, logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Replica skipping")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CommitToAofAsync_LogsError_OnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var manager = new MockedSingleDatabaseManager();

            // Setup to throw exception
            manager.Setup(m => m.AppendOnlyFile.CommitAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                   .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
                () => manager.Object.CommitToAofAsync(logger: loggerMock.Object));

            // Assert logging occurred
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Exception raised while committing to AOF")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test double to make protected methods accessible and mock dependencies
    public class MockedSingleDatabaseManager : SingleDatabaseManager
    {
        public MockedSingleDatabaseManager() : base(null!, null!, createDefaultDatabase: false)
        {
            defaultDatabase = new MockGarnetDatabase(0);
        }

        public Mock<StoreWrapper> StoreWrapper { get; } = new();
        public Mock<AppendOnlyFile> AppendOnlyFile { get; } = new();

        public Mock<GarnetDatabase> DefaultDatabaseMock => Mock.Get(defaultDatabase as MockGarnetDatabase)!;

        protected override Task<bool> TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(int dbId, CancellationToken token = default)
            => throw new NotImplementedException();

        protected override void ResumeCheckpoints(GarnetDatabase database) { }

        protected override Task<(long? storeTailAddress, long? objectStoreTailAddress)> TakeCheckpointAsync(GarnetDatabase database, ILogger? logger = null, CancellationToken token = default)
            => throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    public class MockGarnetDatabase : GarnetDatabase
    {
        public MockGarnetDatabase(int id) : base(id, null!, true) { }
    }
}

using System;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsAofSizeLimitInfo_WhenAofSizeExceedsLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.TailAddress).Returns(1000L);
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.BeginAddress).Returns(0L);

            var manager = new TestSingleDatabaseManager();
            manager.SetDependencies(
                appendOnlyFile: mockAppendOnlyFile.Object,
                tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult: true,
                takeCheckpointResult: (1001L, (long?)1002L));

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(v => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit") && 
                                               v.ToString().Contains("currentAofSize: 1000") &&
                                               v.ToString().Contains("AofSizeLimit: 500")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsReplicaSkippingInfo_WhenInClusterReplicaMode()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.TailAddress).Returns(1000L);
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.BeginAddress).Returns(0L);

            var manager = new TestSingleDatabaseManager();
            manager.SetDependencies(
                appendOnlyFile: mockAppendOnlyFile.Object,
                storeWrapperOptionsEnableCluster: true,
                clusterProviderIsReplica: true,
                tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult: true);

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(v => v.ToString().Contains("Replica skipping")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CommitToAofAsync_LogsError_OnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<SingleDatabaseManager>>();
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.TailAddress).Returns(1234L);
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.CommittedUntilAddress).Returns(567L);
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(a => a.CommitAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                             .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            var manager = new TestSingleDatabaseManager();
            manager.SetDependencies(appendOnlyFile: mockAppendOnlyFile.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
                () => manager.CommitToAofAsync(logger: logger.Object));

            // Assert logging occurred
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat>(),
                    It.Is<Exception>(e => e == ex),
                    It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>((func, t) => 
                        func(null, ex).Contains("Exception raised while committing to AOF") &&
                        func(null, ex).Contains("tailAddress = 1234") &&
                        func(null, ex).Contains("commitAddress = 567"))),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    public class TestSingleDatabaseManager : SingleDatabaseManager
    {
        public TestSingleDatabaseManager() : base(null!, null!, createDefaultDatabase: false)
        {
            defaultDatabase = new TestGarnetDatabase(0);
        }

        public void SetDependencies(
            AppendOnlyFile? appendOnlyFile = null,
            StoreWrapper? storeWrapper = null,
            bool tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult = false,
            (long? storeTailAddress, long? objectStoreTailAddress) takeCheckpointResult = default,
            bool storeWrapperOptionsEnableCluster = false,
            bool clusterProviderIsReplica = false)
        {
            AppendOnlyFile = appendOnlyFile ?? AppendOnlyFile;
            StoreWrapper = storeWrapper ?? StoreWrapper;

            _tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult = tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult;
            _takeCheckpointResult = takeCheckpointResult;
            _storeWrapperOptionsEnableCluster = storeWrapperOptionsEnableCluster;
            _clusterProviderIsReplica = clusterProviderIsReplica;
        }

        private bool _tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult;
        private (long? storeTailAddress, long? objectStoreTailAddress) _takeCheckpointResult;
        private bool _storeWrapperOptionsEnableCluster;
        private bool _clusterProviderIsReplica;

        protected override Task<bool> TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(int dbId, CancellationToken token = default)
            => Task.FromResult(_tryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsyncResult);

        protected override Task<(long? storeTailAddress, long? objectStoreTailAddress)> 
            TakeCheckpointAsync(GarnetDatabase database, ILogger? logger = null, CancellationToken token = default)
            => Task.FromResult(_takeCheckpointResult);

        protected override void ResumeCheckpoints(GarnetDatabase database) { }

        public new AppendOnlyFile AppendOnlyFile => base.AppendOnlyFile;
        public new StoreWrapper StoreWrapper => base.StoreWrapper;

        protected new StoreWrapper storeWrapper => base.storeWrapper;
    }

    public class TestGarnetDatabase : GarnetDatabase
    {
        public TestGarnetDatabase(int id) : base(id, null!, true) { }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsAofSizeLimitInfo_WhenConditionsMet()
        {
            // Arrange - using NullLogger to avoid real logging issues, verify via VerifyAll
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            SetupLoggerForAofSizeLimit(logger);

            var mockAof = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.TailAddress).Returns(1000L);
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.BeginAddress).Returns(0L);

            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(x => x.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(false);

            var manager = CreateTestableManager(mockAof.Object, storeWrapperMock.Object);

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.VerifyAll();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsReplicaSkipping_WhenClusterReplica()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            SetupLoggerForReplicaSkipping(logger);

            var mockAof = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.TailAddress).Returns(1000L);
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.BeginAddress).Returns(0L);

            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(x => x.serverOptions.EnableCluster).Returns(true);
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(x => x.clusterProvider.IsReplica()).Returns(true);

            var manager = CreateTestableManager(mockAof.Object, storeWrapperMock.Object);

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.VerifyAll();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CommitToAofAsync_LogsError_OnCommitException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            SetupLoggerForCommitError(logger);

            var mockAof = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.TailAddress).Returns(1234L);
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.CommittedUntilAddress).Returns(567L);
            mockAof.Setup(x => x.CommitAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                   .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Test commit failure"));

            var manager = CreateTestableManager(mockAof.Object, nullStoreWrapper: null);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
                () => manager.CommitToAofAsync(logger: logger.Object));

            logger.VerifyAll();
        }

        private static TestableSingleDatabaseManager CreateTestableManager(
            IAppendOnlyFile appendOnlyFile, 
            IStoreWrapper? storeWrapper)
        {
            var mockDbCreator = new Mock<StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate>();
            mockDbCreator.Setup(x => x(It.IsAny<int>())).Returns(new MockGarnetDatabase(0));

            var storeWrapperMock = storeWrapper ?? Mock.Of<IStoreWrapper>();
            var manager = new TestableSingleDatabaseManager(mockDbCreator.Object, storeWrapperMock);
            manager.InjectAppendOnlyFile(appendOnlyFile);
            manager.InjectTryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(true);
            return manager;
        }

        private static void SetupLoggerForAofSizeLimit(Mock<ILogger> logger)
        {
            logger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                    ((string)v).Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize") &&
                    ((string)v).Contains("AofSizeLimit")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));
        }

        private static void SetupLoggerForReplicaSkipping(Mock<ILogger> logger)
        {
            logger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v).Contains("Replica skipping")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));
        }

        private static void SetupLoggerForCommitError(Mock<ILogger> logger)
        {
            logger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));
        }
    }

    // Interfaces for mockable dependencies
    public interface IAppendOnlyFile
    {
        long TailAddress { get; }
        long BeginAddress { get; }
        long CommittedUntilAddress { get; }
        Task CommitAsync(CancellationToken token = default);
    }

    public interface IStoreWrapper
    {
        ServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
        IClusterProvider clusterProvider { get; }
    }

    public interface IClusterProvider
    {
        bool IsReplica();
    }

    // Test double that doesn't inherit from internal class
    public class TestableSingleDatabaseManager
    {
        private readonly StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate _dbCreator;
        private readonly IStoreWrapper _storeWrapper;
        private IAppendOnlyFile _appendOnlyFile = NullAppendOnlyFile.Instance;
        private bool _tryPauseResult = false;

        public TestableSingleDatabaseManager(
            StoreWrapper.DatabaseCreatorDelegate dbCreator, 
            IStoreWrapper storeWrapper)
        {
            _dbCreator = dbCreator;
            _storeWrapper = storeWrapper;
        }

        public void InjectAppendOnlyFile(IAppendOnlyFile appendOnlyFile) => 
            _appendOnlyFile = appendOnlyFile;

        public void InjectTryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(bool result) => 
            _tryPauseResult = result;

        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(long aofSizeLimit,
            CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            var aofSize = _appendOnlyFile.TailAddress - _appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress;
            if (aofSize <= aofSizeLimit) return;

            if (!await TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(0, token: token)) return;

            try
            {
                if (_storeWrapper.serverOptions.EnableCluster && _storeWrapper.clusterProvider.IsReplica())
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Replica skipping {method}", nameof(TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync));
                    return;
                }

                logger?.LogInformation("Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize: {aofSize} >  AofSizeLimit: {aofSizeLimit}",
                    _appendOnlyFile.TailAddress - _appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress, aofSizeLimit);
            }
            finally
            {
                ResumeCheckpoints(0);
            }
        }

        public async Task CommitToAofAsync(CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            try
            {
                await _appendOnlyFile.CommitAsync(token: token);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex,
                    "Exception raised while committing to AOF. AOF tail address = {tailAddress}; AOF committed until address = {commitAddress}; ",
                    _appendOnlyFile.TailAddress, _appendOnlyFile.CommittedUntilAddress);
                throw;
            }
        }

        private Task<bool> TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(int dbId, CancellationToken token) => 
            Task.FromResult(_tryPauseResult);

        private void ResumeCheckpoints(int dbId) { }
    }

    public class NullAppendOnlyFile : IAppendOnlyFile
    {
        public static readonly NullAppendOnlyFile Instance = new();
        public long TailAddress => 0;
        public long BeginAddress => 0;
        public long CommittedUntilAddress => 0;
        public Task CommitAsync(CancellationToken token = default) => Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public class MockGarnetDatabase
    {
        public MockGarnetDatabase(int id) { }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server.Tests
{
    public class SingleDatabaseManagerLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsAofSizeLimitInfo_WhenAofSizeExceedsLimit()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            logger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Enforcing AOF size limit")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

            var manager = new TestableSingleDatabaseManager();
            manager.SetAofSize(1000L, 0L); // aofSize = 1000 > limit 500
            manager.SetTryPauseResult(true);
            manager.SetClusterMode(false, false);

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.VerifyAll();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync_LogsReplicaSkippingInfo_WhenInClusterReplicaMode()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            logger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Replica skipping")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

            var manager = new TestableSingleDatabaseManager();
            manager.SetAofSize(1000L, 0L);
            manager.SetTryPauseResult(true);
            manager.SetClusterMode(true, true); // enableCluster=true, isReplica=true

            // Act
            await manager.TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(500, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.VerifyAll();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CommitToAofAsync_LogsError_OnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            logger.Setup(x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

            var manager = new TestableSingleDatabaseManager();
            manager.SetAofProperties(1234L, 567L);
            manager.SetCommitThrows(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
                () => manager.CommitToAofAsync(logger: logger.Object));

            // Assert
            logger.VerifyAll();
        }
    }

    public class TestableSingleDatabaseManager
    {
        private long _aofTailAddress = 0;
        private long _aofBeginAddress = 0;
        private long _aofCommittedUntilAddress = 0;
        private bool _tryPauseResult = false;
        private bool _enableCluster = false;
        private bool _isReplica = false;
        private Exception? _commitException;

        public void SetAofSize(long tailAddress, long beginAddress)
        {
            _aofTailAddress = tailAddress;
            _aofBeginAddress = beginAddress;
        }

        public void SetAofProperties(long tailAddress, long committedUntilAddress)
        {
            _aofTailAddress = tailAddress;
            _aofCommittedUntilAddress = committedUntilAddress;
        }

        public void SetTryPauseResult(bool result) => _tryPauseResult = result;

        public void SetClusterMode(bool enableCluster, bool isReplica)
        {
            _enableCluster = enableCluster;
            _isReplica = isReplica;
        }

        public void SetCommitThrows(Exception ex) => _commitException = ex;

        public async Task TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync(long aofSizeLimit,
            CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            var aofSize = _aofTailAddress - _aofBeginAddress;
            if (aofSize <= aofSizeLimit) return;

            if (!await TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(0, token: token).ConfigureAwait(false))
                return;

            try
            {
                // Checkpoint will be triggered from AOF replay
                if (_enableCluster && _isReplica)
                {
                    logger?.LogInformation("Replica skipping {method}", nameof(TaskCheckpointBasedOnAofSizeLimitAsync));
                    return;
                }

                logger?.LogInformation("Enforcing AOF size limit currentAofSize: {aofSize} >  AofSizeLimit: {aofSizeLimit}",
                    aofSize, aofSizeLimit);

                // Simulate the rest of the method
                await TaskCheckpointRestAsync();
            }
            finally
            {
                ResumeCheckpoints(0);
            }
        }

        public async Task CommitToAofAsync(CancellationToken token = default, ILogger logger = null)
        {
            try
            {
                await CommitAsync(token: token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger?.LogError(ex,
                    "Exception raised while committing to AOF. AOF tail address = {tailAddress}; AOF committed until address = {commitAddress}; ",
                    _aofTailAddress, _aofCommittedUntilAddress);
                throw;
            }
        }

        private Task<bool> TryPauseCheckpointsContinuousAsync(int dbId, CancellationToken token = default)
            => Task.FromResult(_tryPauseResult);

        private Task CommitAsync(CancellationToken token = default)
        {
            if (_commitException != null)
                throw _commitException;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        private Task TaskCheckpointRestAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;
        private void ResumeCheckpoints(int dbId) { }
    }
}
